data.name: Domain Secret
data.description: You choose %1 domain spells. Those spells becomes permanently modified with one of the following metamagic feats: Bouncing Spell, Disruptive Spell, Ectoplasmic Spell, Enlarge Spell, Extend Spell, Focused Spell, Intensified Spell, Silent Spell, Still Spell. This metamagic feat does not increase the level of the spell. Once chosen, this modification cannot be changed. You need not have the metamagic feat to apply it to a spell using this ability. You cannot modify the same spell more than once.|DomainSecrets
